page.layout: One centred title block: "IN", then the title in large capitals, then the author's name and place of origin in spaced capitals. Below it, a small italic block of four lines to the right of the library stamp, too faint to read. Below that, an empty engraved frame (a plate or vignette). Then the place and printer's imprint at the foot. The Zurich library stamp is not transcribed.
page.notes: The title block is partly faint and has show-through from the reverse, which I have not transcribed. "PROLOGEM" and "EPI-" are doubtful; the end of the author line ("GVALTHERO") is split across two lines and read only in part. The four-line italic block beside the stamp is illegible. The imprint lines at the foot (printer, town and date) are very faint; the date is a best reading and should be checked against the scan. The engraved frame in the centre is empty of readable text. The Zurich library stamp (Stadtbibliothek Zürich) is excluded.
